segments.title: CAM-00 • HIGH BASALT SHELF TOWER OUTPOST
segments.subtitle: This is GOR-9. This is GOR-9 [ding-ding] Galactic Outpost Radio, broadcasting from the High Basalt Shelf on Asteroid 3-5-1 in Sector 9.

segments.title: CONSOLE 1 • METEO-9 • SECTOR 9 MAGNETOSPHERIC RADAR
segments.subtitle: Space Weather, with emphasis on Sector 9. Coreward lanes are calm—solar flux 174, K-index 2. Locally, an electrostatic dust squall on the Meridian Plateau has engulfed Relay KZ9-OMEGA (60 kV arcing, marzelvane #4 phase-wobble, SINPO 2-3-2-2-2).

segments.title: CONSOLE 2 • ECON-9 • CERES SPOT EXCHANGE & REACTOR STEP-DOWN
segments.subtitle: Outpost Economics: Grade-B Deuterium pellets +4% following Quarry 44-K dragline slowdown. Reactor #2 stepping down to 12 kW after midnight. Supply tender held at Quarantine Buoy 12 ('fermented brine tubers').

segments.title: CONSOLE 3 • HAUSER MK-IV CORRELATOR • DX LOGS

sub_views.label: 3,890 kHz CW • TITAN-MINOR BUOY N-24
sub_views.subtitle: On the Hauser Correlator: Titan-Minor, 3,890 kHz. Hydrographic Buoy N-24 reciting methane tide tables, while migratory silt-striders rub against the guy-wires, detuning the whip antenna.

sub_views.label: 11,410 kHz AM • CALLISTO DOME-4 'RADIO CORRUGATED'
sub_views.subtitle: Callisto Dome Four, 11,410 kHz. Unlicensed noodle-market broadcaster Radio Corrugated, peaking right as their engineer hit the dipole with a blowtorch.

sub_views.label: 1,420.405 MHz • INTERGALACTIC M-33 DRIFT BUOY
sub_views.subtitle: And Intergalactic, M-33: a 700-year-old drift-buoy still issuing small-craft warnings for an ammonia sea that evaporated in the Ming Dynasty.

segments.title: CONSOLE 4 • EUCLID-9 • THE UNSUSPECTING PARALLELOGRAM (I.34 / G.47)

steps.subtitle: Euclid Signal Detector alert (03:12 UTC): inside unmanned Brine Evaporation Vat 19 on Callisto-South, Frame 7 locked onto an unsuspecting parallelogram in the salt crust.
Opposite sides parallel to 0.0002 arcsec (AB || CD, AC || BD)—and somebody drew the diameter BC, bisecting the sludge into two congruent triangles (Euclid I.34 / G.47).
The Water Board claims a motorized mud-rake lost a cotter pin and dragged sideways. It's always a broken cotter pin, folks.

segments.title: CONSOLE 5 • SCHED-9 & SIGN-OFF -> CAM-00 TOWER
segments.subtitle: On the next broadcast: an unlicensed numbers station in the Trojans reciting dumpling recipes in base-8, and a suspected rhombus aboard an ice-hauler. From Asteroid 3-5-1 in Sector 9, this is GOR-9—your eye to the cosmos, ear to the vacuum.

segments.title: O.R.S. 351 • ORBITAL SATELLITE DOWNLINK & END CARDS
segments.subtitle: Remember, a like indication on your listening apparatus gives us three kilowatts, and a subscription gets us one step closer to upgrading our marzelvane emitters.
